subject: Geopolitics
title: Sanctions as a Foreign Policy Tool
description: A quick, practical guide to Sanctions as a Foreign Policy Tool.

hook.text: When diplomacy fails and war costs too much, nations reach for a third option: squeeze the economy.

buildup.text: Sanctions restrict trade, freeze assets, or block finance. They punish without a single soldier.

discovery.text: The logic is simple: make bad behavior expensive. If the cost of defiance outweighs the benefit, states comply.

twist.text: But sanctions rarely work fast. Targeted regimes adapt, and ordinary citizens often suffer first.

climax.text: Sanctions sit between words and war. Powerful but imprecise, they remain the go-to modern weapon.

punchline.text: Money is a weapon. Cutting it off is a strategy.

quiz.question: What is the basic logic behind sanctions?
options: Replace diplomacy with permanent trade bans
